column2: [intro]
I’m a bird that wants to soar high,
A mischievous cat in a city that’s alive,
I need freedom just to breathe,
I want to dance and to leave.
Freedom, oh, it’s my pride,
I want to feel it, touch it with my hands,
Freedom, oh, I’m satisfied,
Living without limits, without any demands.
I’m a clown, always ready to cheer,
A juggler of ideas, never in fear,
I challenge the rules, I love to play,
Freedom is my creed, my knight every day.
Freedom, oh, it’s my pride,
I want to feel it, touch it with my hands,
Freedom, oh, I’m satisfied,
Living without limits, without any demands.
[ solo ]
Freedom, my faithful friend,
It’s the key that unlocks all wonders,
So I sing, I laugh, I ascend,
In this world where nothing else plunders.
[outro]
